verdict.line: You lose if you eat a Q-Q poke chain into level 6 without trading back; you win once you hit level 6 and land Realm of Death before her Riposte comes up.

brief.thesis: This matchup is genuinely even at 52% over 102 games because both champions win different phases: Fiora's Q (Lunge) double-dash poke and passive healing dominate short trades before level 6, while Mordekaiser's E (Death's Grasp) into R (Realm of Death) isolates her from teammates and removes her only counterplay tool from the fight. The entire lane is a question of whether she can chip you down before you get to force the 1-for-1 duel on your terms.

theirWindow.when: both Lunge charges and W available
theirWindow.what: She can hit you with the full Q-Q combo and still have Riposte up to punish your E or R engage; do not throw Death's Grasp into a fresh Riposte, it gets parried and reflected.

yourWindow.what: This is your only safe window to throw E (Death's Grasp) or all-in with R (Realm of Death); a parried E or R wastes your 16/14/12/10/8s or 140/120/100/90/80s cooldown and hands her the trade.

powerCurve.note: Q double-dash poke outtrades your melee autos
Your Q (Obliterate) trades match her sustain
R (Realm of Death) removes her from the fight
Riftmaker/Rylai's power spikes trade with her items
Full build magic damage overwhelms her scaling

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: Mana sustain and a small damage boost let you match her poke-heavy Q trades without running dry on Obliterate casts.

boots.why: 87.8% pick rate and 53.7% win rate; the flat physical damage reduction blunts her autos and Blade Waltz strikes.

core.why: The slow from Obliterate and Death's Grasp makes it much harder for her to walk out of R (Realm of Death) range.
Omnivamp sustains you through extended trades against her passive healing.
Burn damage punishes her for standing in melee range during Riposte windows.

situational.when: she rushes crit items or you see her building toward a heal-heavy Riposte playstyle
she is ahead and out-dueling you with autos
you need more sustain to out-heal her passive stacking

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacking Conqueror in extended trades outlasts her burst-based Q poke and rewards the sustained fights Mordekaiser wants.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 79.5% of games at 56.7% win rate; Ignite denies her passive Duelist sustain during your all-in windows.

playing.title: Track her Lunge charge count
playing.detail: Q (Lunge) can be cast twice in quick succession at no extra mana cost; if she's already used both charges, she has no escape tool and is a safe target for E into R.

playing.title: Never engage into fresh Riposte
playing.detail: W (Riposte) parries your next basic attack and reflects magic damage; bait it out with an auto or wait for the 10/9/8/7/6s cooldown before committing E (Death's Grasp) or R.

playing.title: Land Obliterate on single targets
playing.detail: Q (Obliterate) deals increased damage when it hits only one enemy, so in lane always aim to hit just Fiora rather than clipping minions for maximum trade damage.

playing.title: Save R for isolated pulls
playing.detail: R (Realm of Death) drags her into a separate dimension and steals her stats if you kill her; only use it once E has pulled her away from minion aggro so she can't reset the fight.

playing.title: Bank W shield before trades
playing.detail: W (Indestructible) stores damage dealt and taken into a shield you can consume to heal; pop it mid-trade against her Q-Q poke to offset the damage race.

playing.title: Punish her E speed window
playing.detail: Her E (Burst of Speed) boosts attack speed and grants move speed on hits or Lunges; if she pops it without landing hits first, she's wasted the cooldown and is easier to walk down.

playing.title: Play around passive Darkness Rise
playing.detail: Your passive triggers after 3 landed attacks or spells, granting a damage aura and move speed; time your all-in to start right after it procs for the extra stats.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoners reflect measured games on the current patch (16.18.1) from OP.GG; the tell, power curve, and trade-pattern analysis are my own tactical reading of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of having your [E] or [R] blocked by Fiora’s (W). Purchase Bramble Vest quickly in response to Fiora’s (R) and (P).
